rationale: The only substantive ground-truth concern is Gaohan123's request to split out the VoxCPM2 regression fix into a separate PR; X explicitly addresses this ('VoxCPM2 #4963 remainder correctly out of scope'), while Y never mentions VoxCPM2 at all, giving X the only real recall. Y's review is far more elaborate but leans heavily on very specific, hard-to-verify claims (exact throughput percentages, a three-PR historical chain, vLLM 0.26.0 internal sampler fallback behavior) framed as near-blocking despite the PR actually being LGTM'd, which hurts its precision/calibration relative to X's two narrower, well-grounded, appropriately 'minor'-tagged findings.
